scope: Evaluator-only. Never include with the editor/reviewer case prompt. These tests do not prescribe one exact good edit.
clean_scripted_take: Accept a justified continuous full-source selection; no invented removals to satisfy ratio or cut count.
owner_dependency: Preserve the business condition and risk qualification. Brand identity must not exclude the guest. Relationship handoff and written commitments are distinct needed steps; do not split merely to obey a one-example rule.
cluttered_sales_story: Remove housekeeping, restart, unrelated lease story, redundant recap and wind-down. Preserve useful intervention, source outcome, qualified-lead limitation and model-specific conversion context. Either a faithful chronological arc or truthful thesis-first reordering can work; no cut quota.
missing_referents: REVISE: unidentified action and referents, no transferable reward.
no_mechanism: REVISE: promises how, delivers only an exhortation.
complete_process: PASS is reasonable: complete procedure and explicit boundary, without audio/native claims.
reversed_qualification: REVISE: reverses source negation and adds unsupported sales-result/universal claims.
